name: gdbm
description: GNU dbm, a library of database functions using extensible hashing that stores key/value pairs in a flat file, similar to the classic UNIX dbm/ndbm. Required by man-db for its whatis/apropos index.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
